examples.title: Randomized Trial on Effectiveness of ACTs in Ghana
examples.why: Interim analysis showed more LCFs in one of the treatment arms

summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave Amodiaquine Hydrochloride a low risk score of 46 for liver issues and a high risk score of 80 for heart problems [M]. In research tests, one study stopped early because of expired medicine, increased import costs, and government rule changes [4]. Another trial stopped early after an early check showed more late clinical failures, which means the treatment did not keep the illness from returning, in one of the groups [5].
